responsibility: Simulates target storage layout and bit patterns for front-end constants and initializers. It computes element and aggregate sizes, encodes and interprets values in target byte order, builds character and derived-type images, and applies the encoded representations to BOZ, EQUIVALENCE, and other constant-initialization paths.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable target-memory simulation behind target-memory.h: it computes element/aggregate sizes, encodes constants into target byte images, interprets buffers back into expressions, merges overlapping EQUIVALENCE initializers, and performs BOZ bit-pattern conversion. The header only exposes these entry points.
